Title: Login with valid credentials (standard_user)
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Open saucedemo.com 2) Enter standard_user / secret_sauce 3) Click Login
Expected Result: Redirect to the Products page

Title: Login with locked out user
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Open saucedemo.com 2) Enter locked_out_user / secret_sauce 3) Click Login
Expected Result: Error: 'Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

Title: Login with invalid password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Open saucedemo.com 2) Enter standard_user / wrong_password 3) Click Login
Expected Result: Error: username/password do not match; stays on login page

Title: Login with empty username
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Leave username empty 2) Enter password 3) Click Login
Expected Result: Error: 'Username is required'

Title: Login with empty password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Enter username 2) Leave password empty 3) Click Login
Expected Result: Error: 'Password is required'

Title: Login with empty username and password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1) Leave both fields empty 2) Click Login
Expected Result: Error: 'Username is required'

Title: Products page displays 6 items after login
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Observe the products list
Expected Result: 6 products, each with image, name, description, price and Add to cart

Title: Sort products by Name (A to Z)
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Open sort dropdown 2) Select 'Name (A to Z)'
Expected Result: Products sorted A to Z by name

Title: Sort products by Name (Z to A)
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Open sort dropdown 2) Select 'Name (Z to A)'
Expected Result: Products sorted Z to A by name

Title: Sort products by Price (low to high)
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Open sort dropdown 2) Select 'Price (low to high)'
Expected Result: Products sorted by ascending price

Title: Sort products by Price (high to low)
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Open sort dropdown 2) Select 'Price (high to low)'
Expected Result: Products sorted by descending price

Title: Add a single item to the cart
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Click Add to cart on one product 2) Observe the cart icon
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 1; button changes to Remove

Title: Add multiple items to the cart
Preconditions: User is on the Products page
Steps: 1) Click Add to cart on three products 2) Observe the cart icon
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 3

Title: Remove item from the Products page
Preconditions: User has 1 item in the cart
Steps: 1) Add one product 2) Click Remove on the same product
Expected Result: Badge count decreases; button reverts to Add to cart

Title: Cart page shows correct items and prices
Preconditions: User has added 2 items
Steps: 1) Add 2 products 2) Click the cart icon
Expected Result: Correct products, quantities (1 each) and prices listed

Title: Continue Shopping returns to Products page
Preconditions: User is on the cart page
Steps: 1) Open the cart page 2) Click Continue Shopping
Expected Result: Redirect back to the Products page

Title: Remove item from the cart page
Preconditions: User has 1 item in the cart, on the cart page
Steps: 1) Open the cart page 2) Click Remove next to the item
Expected Result: Item removed; badge count decreases

Title: Complete checkout with valid information
Preconditions: User has at least 1 item in the cart
Steps: 1) Cart -> Checkout 2) Enter First/Last name and Postal Code 3) Continue 4) Finish
Expected Result: Confirmation: 'Thank you for your order!'

Title: Checkout with empty First Name
Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page
Steps: 1) Start checkout 2) Leave First Name empty 3) Enter Last name and Postal Code 4) Continue
Expected Result: Error: 'First Name is required'

Title: Checkout with empty Last Name
Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page
Steps: 1) Start checkout 2) Enter First Name 3) Leave Last Name empty 4) Enter Postal Code 5) Continue
Expected Result: Error: 'Last Name is required'

Title: Checkout with empty Postal Code
Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page
Steps: 1) Start checkout 2) Enter First and Last name 3) Leave Postal Code empty 4) Continue
Expected Result: Error: 'Postal Code is required'

Title: Checkout overview shows correct totals
Preconditions: User has 1 item in the cart
Steps: 1) Complete info and Continue 2) Review the overview totals
Expected Result: Total equals Item total plus Tax

Title: Cancel on the Overview page returns to Products
Preconditions: User is on the checkout Overview page
Steps: 1) Reach the Overview page 2) Click Cancel
Expected Result: User returns to the Products page

Title: Logout returns to the login page
Preconditions: User is logged in
Steps: 1) Open the hamburger menu 2) Click Logout
Expected Result: User is logged out and returned to the login page

Title: Reset App State clears the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in with items in the cart
Steps: 1) Add items 2) Menu -> Reset App State 3) Observe product buttons
Expected Result: Badge cleared AND product buttons reset to Add to cart

Title: Access inventory URL without login is blocked
Preconditions: User is NOT logged in
Steps: 1) Open saucedemo.com/inventory.html directly without logging in
Expected Result: Access denied; redirect to the login page
